_about: The token tree build_tokens.py turns into tokens.json. forhers.com has no named token layer on the marketing stack: core.space and core.layout export the /shop bundle's --unit-u*/--spacing-s*/--grid-*/--*Height scales, core.palette harvests the literal colours the archived inline sheets declare (ink on white, sage and cream surfaces, the #338585 teal ramp, lime and clay accents), core.typography and light.component are computed styles measured on the same archived pages. core.font names the measured faces: sofia-pro/SofiaProWeb UI sans and the CareSans display face.

sans.source: computed fontFamily of article-card default (raw/components-computed.json); blog-topic and the other blog/prose components match (nav-link and footer measure CareSans)

serif.description: Declared faces only: Regular and Italic, unicode-range subsets, font-display: swap. No SSR rule applies it — the marketing display face is CareSans.
